Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Class EntitySelector

java.lang.Object
ke.ric.renderer.api.EntitySelector
public final class EntitySelector extends Object
Immutable predicate over copied entity metadata. It never reads a live Bukkit entity and does not capture additional entities. Use types, UUIDs and living/player categories, then combine selectors with and(EntitySelector), or(EntitySelector) and not(). Selectors cannot override request exclusions or viewer privacy.
